verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a Marketplace app, 'GitHub for Atlassian', which syncs development data and automates workflows across GitHub and Jira. It is an add-on integration, and the description does not say Jira items can be created, edited or transitioned from within GitHub's UI. GitHub's own issues and projects (github-docs-12) are native trackers, not external ones, so they do not count toward this story. Missing for 10: evidence that external tracker items can be managed directly in the GitHub UI, first-party documentation of that workflow, coverage of trackers beyond Jira, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
